name: Amazon Marketing Stream
shortInfo: Receive hourly Amazon Ads campaign metrics and information on campaign changes in near real time.
brief: Amazon Marketing Stream connector enables streaming of relevant Amazon Marketing Stream datasets into a user determined data warehouse.
about: Amazon Marketing Stream is a data-streaming service that partners or advertisers can use to subscribe to advertising data sets. It enables partners and advertisers to use AWS services natively to receive and process advertising data.
availableData:
[Dataset Subscription](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-marketing-stream/pipelines/dataset-subscription.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve datasets that advertisers have subscribed to.
